description: This file contains configuration and utility functions for integrating MonkeyType with Torch JIT, including class definitions for trace storage and filtering, and functions for type conversion and class inspection.

classes.name: JitTypeTraceStoreLogger
classes.description: Logs trace data into a CallTraceStore, used for storing MonkeyType traces.

classes.name: JitTypeTraceStore
classes.description: Stores and manages collected CallTrace objects, supports adding, filtering, and analyzing traces.

classes.name: JitTypeTraceConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for MonkeyType tracing, providing trace logger, store, and code filter.

methods.name: is_torch_native_class
methods.description: Checks if a class is defined in the torch.* modules.

methods.name: get_type
methods.description: Converts a type to a TorchScript acceptable string format.

methods.name: get_optional_of_element_type
methods.description: Extracts element type from a list of types and formats as Optional.

methods.name: get_qualified_name
methods.description: Returns the qualified name of a function.

methods.name: jit_code_filter
methods.description: Custom code filter for tracing forward calls in TorchScript, excluding stdlib and site-packages.
